visual_grammar.label: 8K 3D Endoscopic Biomedical Cinematography + 4-Mode Physiological Storytelling
three_pillars: 3D volumetric endoscopic flythrough of beating heart, cortical synapses, lungs, and blood vessels
100mm macro cellular bio-mechanism, hormone cascade, and immune defense physics without graphic gore
Human everyday habit trigger seamlessly cutting into internal 3D X-ray skeletal/organ response
visual_grammar.anti_repetition_rule: Vary organ scale, cellular focal depth, and lighting contrast per beat; strictly zero 2D flat cartoon stickers (kawaii) or doodle stickmen in V3; allowed_text=None on raw Flow frames.

MODE_1_BIOMETRIC_STAMP.role: Bold 2K biometric metric callout card (Clinical Cyan #06B6D4 / Crimson #EF4444) on critical physiological thresholds

MODE_2_NORMAL_VS_STRESS_SPLIT.role: Vertical glowing Cyan vs Crimson split comparison contrasting healthy homeostasis against stress overload

MODE_3_CASCADE_CHECKLIST.role: Right-docked dark slate biotech card (#0F172A) listing sequential [01]/[02]/[03] biological stages or recovery steps

MODE_4_ENDOSCOPIC_PACING.role: Uncluttered 2K full-bleed 3D biomedical cinematography with 1.045x overscan static Lanczos + xfade=fade:duration=0.20 and key-beat I2V motion
